moments.author: Jacob Coxon
moments.quote: OpenAI and Anthropic are racing straight to self‑improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives.

moments.author: Donald Trump

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.why: His public backing of OpenAI’s Sam Altman in the AI‑pause debate is fueling tech chatter today.

moments.author: AnthropicAI
moments.quote: We’re publishing our most detailed threat intelligence report to date … how people tried to misuse Claude … and how we found and stopped them.
